basis: ADR-0044 (2026-11-01): the channel is instrumental deep-focus electronic music for coding and deep work. An arm is in identity only when its use case is a focus use case, its genre is focus_electronic or unset, and it is not vocal. Unset genres are admitted because P3 infers focus_electronic for focus use cases. v2 (2026-11-01) drops ambient, synthwave and deep_house: P3 would produce them from their own genre templates (drone, neon, build-and-drop dance), which are outside the identity.
